answer: Require each new identity to post a small non-refundable admission stake, then let peer-attested work alone grow its voting weight. A fresh account enters like an unbadged boat at the jetty: it may fly a signal, but a faint one, until repeated honest attestations earn influence. A sybil farmer pays the stake N times for N thin voices, and the cluster's joint signal stays weak next to one well-attested participant whose ledger record carries real pigment of effort, so mass registration stops paying; slashing proven collusion makes clusters a liability.
